tables.title: Reported Questions (الكلام المنقول للسؤال)
rows: He asked me how I was.
He asked me where I had been.
'What do you want to do now?'
He asked me what I wanted to do.
He asked me where I had stayed.
He asked me if I was happy to be back.
He asked me if I planned to go back.
He asked me where my parents were.
He asked me if I could help him.
tables.explanation: نستخدم Reported Questions لنقل سؤال شخص آخر. نستخدم أفعال مثل: asked, inquired, wondered, wanted to know. الفعل المساعد يتغير حسب الزمن.
tables.examples: He asked me how I was. / She asked if I had been to London.

tables.title: Reported Questions - تحويل زمن الفعل
rows: She asked me where the Post Office was.
She asked me who that fantastic man had been.
When has he met his friend?
My mother wanted to know when he had met his friend.
He inquired why I was crying.
tables.explanation: عند تحويل السؤال إلى غير مباشر، تتغير أزمنة الأفعال إلى الوراء: المضارع البسيط → ماضي بسيط، الماضي البسيط → ماضي تام، المضارع التام → ماضي تام، المضارع المستمر → ماضي مستمر.
tables.examples: He asked me where I was. / She wanted to know if I had finished.

tables.title: Yes/No Questions في الكلام غير المباشر
rows: He asked me whether I knew him.
She asked me if I had ever been to Mexico.
She asked me if I was living there.
tables.explanation: عند تحويل سؤال يبدأ بـ Yes/No، نستخدم 'if' أو 'whether' في الكلام غير المباشر.
tables.examples: He asked if I knew him. / She asked whether I had been to Mexico.

tables.title: التغييرات في الكلام غير المباشر
rows: the previous day / the day before
tables.explanation: في الكلام غير المباشر، تتغير ضمائر الملكية وأدوات الزمان والمكان حسب السياق.
tables.examples: He said, 'I am here now.' → He said that he was there then.

tables.title: Reported Questions مع أفعال أخرى
rows: He asked me where I was.
They wanted to know if I had a computer.
She wondered why he was late.
He inquired why I was crying.
tables.explanation: يمكن استخدام أفعال متنوعة لنقل السؤال غير المباشر، ولكن 'asked' هو الأكثر شيوعاً.
tables.examples: She wanted to know if I was ready. / He wondered where I had been.

tables.title: Pronunciation - Short /ʊ/ و Long /u:/
tables.explanation: الصوت القصير /ʊ/ يظهر في كلمات مثل (put, look, full) والصوت الطويل /u:/ يظهر في كلمات مثل (shoot, juice, school).
tables.examples: Listen and repeat: put vs shoot, look vs juice, full vs fool.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر)
rows: He took a nap for an hour.
in the end, in the afternoon
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تأتي قبل الاسم أو الضمير ولها استخدامات متعددة حسب السياق.
tables.examples: He arrived at sunset. / She learned from the story.

tables.title: Conjunctions (أدوات الربط)
rows: She likes reading because books give her pleasure.
He felt hot so he sat under a tree.
She didn't expect us, but her mother was in business.
Although he was late, he arrived.
When you do it regularly, you realize...
If you master time management, you can achieve anything.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تستخدم لربط الجمل أو الكلمات.
tables.examples: He lost his chance because he wasted time. / I was tired, so I slept.

tables.title: Conditional Type 2 (النوع الثاني من الشرط)
rows: If Hani worked hard, he wouldn't be poor.
If I had time, I could help.
tables.explanation: النوع الثاني من الشرط يستخدم للتعبير عن مواقف غير حقيقية أو خيالية في الحاضر.
tables.examples: If I had money, I would travel. / If Hani worked hard, he would be rich.

tables.title: Gerund as Subject (اسم الفاعل كفاعل)
tables.explanation: يمكننا بدء الجملة بـ Gerund (فعل + ing) ليكون فاعل الجملة.
tables.examples: Planting trees is important. / Reading improves your knowledge.

tables.title: Possessive Adjectives (صفات الملكية)
tables.explanation: صفات الملكية تأتي قبل الاسم (my book) بينما ضمائر الملكية تحل محل الاسم (This book is mine).
tables.examples: This is her bag. / This bag is hers.

tables.title: Question Words (أدوات الاستفهام)
rows: How much time did you spend?
tables.explanation: أدوات الاستفهام توضع في بداية السؤال ويتبعها الفعل المساعد ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل الرئيسي.
tables.examples: Where did you go? / How long did you stay?

tables.title: Auxiliary Verbs (الأفعال المساعدة)
rows: Are you going to the party?
tables.explanation: الأفعال المساعدة تستخدم لتكوين السؤال والنفي في الأزمنة المختلفة.
tables.examples: Did she finish her homework? / Can you manage your time?
